title: Record
description: One mention of a place, person, event or organisation, as it appears in a source, with its provenance and (for places) its resolution to a gazetteer entry. Output of the text half; input of the maps half.

id.description: Stable hash of (doc_id, page_id, line_index, surface_form, type).

surface_form.description: Verbatim text as written in the source, including historical spelling.

normalized.description: Modern or standard form, if known. Never replaces surface_form.

line_index.description: 0-based line in the transcription, or null if unknown.

bbox.description: [x, y, w, h] in image pixels, or null for backends that do not segment.

transcription_backend.description: backend/model that produced the line, e.g. tesseract/frak2021 or openrouter/qwen/qwen3-vl-30b-a3b-instruct

extraction_method.description: how the mention was found: manual, ner/<model>, llm/<model>, csv

date_start.description: ISO-8601 or EDTF, e.g. 1743, 1743-05, 1743~, 174X. Stored as text.

year_end.description: Derived sortable year from date_end (or date_start).

place_uri.description: GOV / Wikidata / WHG / GeoNames URI of the accepted candidate.

resolution_source.description: which resolver supplied the accepted candidate: gov, wikidata, whg, geonames, manual
